events.name: sb-kanban-move
events.description: A card was dropped, or a keyboard move committed. detail: { cardId, col, before }: col is the lane's data-col as a number, before the id of the card it now precedes in that lane, or "" for the end.

events.name: sb-kanban-select
events.description: A card was selected: arrow focus moved to it, or the pointer pressed it. detail: { cardId }.

events.name: sb-kanban-lane-move
events.description: A lane was dropped by its grip, moved with Alt and the arrows, or stepped. detail: { col, before }: col is its data-col as a number, before the data-col of the lane it now precedes, or "" for the end.
